$comment: How each category of the model looks in every medium, in the order the schema takes from this table: its default Lucide icon, Archify's type for it, whether its parts lie outside the described system, and whether it takes the palette's accent role; then the category of a part that names no kind, and a group's look. src/kinds.mjs reads this table; tools/docs/references.mjs writes the model schema's categories and default category from it, and the model reference's table of categories.
